לפני יותר מארבעה דורות, המייסד שלנו "Cap" Saurage יצר את הקפה הקלוי הכהה שלנו. תערובת מיוחדת זו קלויה כהה כדי לפתח טעם עשיר וחלק עם פרופיל שוקולד עמוק. הצלייה הראשית שלנו מבטיחה שרמת הקלייה המדויקת מושגת כדי ליצור באופן עקבי את הקפה המורכב להפליא הזה שנשאר מועדף היום. מוצר זה מכיל חבילה אחת של 72 קפסולות קפה מנה אחת (Keurig תואם K-Cups™). תיהנו מ-72 כוסות קפה. אודות Community Coffee Since Cap מיזוג את המאצווה הראשונה של קפה קהילתי, ראינו שפע של כסף — גם בתוך ומחוץ לחברה. התפתחנו כדי לשרת טוב יותר את הלקוחות שלנו, אבל ניסינו גם להישאר נאמנים לשורשים שלנו ולקהילה שגרמה לנו להתחיל. לכן כבר מעל 100 שנה שמרנו על מסירות בלתי מתפשרת להכנת הקפה האיכותי והטעים ביותר שאנחנו יכולים — הכל תוך פיתוח שיטות מקור טובות יותר, טכניקות צלייה מעולות ורעיונות חדשניים כדי לשמור על הקפה שלנו בשיא הטעם והרעננות שלו. אנחנו פשוט אוהבים להכין קפה, ואנחנו מוצאים השראה בכל חלק של התהליך, החל משתילת השעועית ועד להגשת הכוס המושלמת. מעל הכל, אנחנו מקבלים השראה מהאנשים שאנחנו עובדים איתם, הלקוחות שאנו משרתים ומהחיבורים שבנינו יחד.

Vor über vier Generationen kreierte unser Gründer "Cap" Saurage unseren unverkennbaren dunklen Röstkaffee. Diese spezielle Mischung ist dunkel geröstet, um einen reichen, glatten Geschmack mit einem tiefen Schokoladenprofil zu entwickeln. Unsere Meisterbräter stellen sicher, dass der genaue Bratgrad erreicht wird, um diesen köstlich komplexen Kaffee konsequent zu kreieren, der heute ein Favorit bleibt. Dieses Produkt enthält eine Packung mit 72 Kaffeepads (Keurig kompatibel K-Cups™). Genießen Sie 72 Tassen Kaffee. Über Community Coffee Since Cap blended the first batch of Community®-Kaffee, we have seen plenty of change — both inside and outside the company. Wir haben uns entwickelt, um unseren Kunden besser zu dienen, aber wir haben auch versucht, unseren Wurzeln und der Gemeinschaft treu zu bleiben. Das ist der Grund, warum wir seit über 100 Jahren ein unerschütterliches Engagement für die Herstellung des besten schmeckenden Kaffees, den wir vielleicht können – und das alles während der Entwicklung besserer Methoden der Beschaffung, überlegener Rösttechniken und innovative Ideen, um unseren Kaffee auf seinem Höchstmaß an Geschmack und Frische zu halten. Wir lieben es, Kaffee zu machen und wir finden Inspiration in jedem Teil des Prozesses, vom Einpflanzen der Bohnen bis zum Servieren der perfekten Tasse. Vor allem sind wir inspiriert von den Menschen, mit denen wir arbeiten, den Kunden, die wir bedienen und den Verbindungen, die wir zusammengebaut haben.

منذ أكثر من أربعة أجيال قام مؤسستنا "كاب" سوراج بابتكار قهوتنا الداكنة المحمصة المميزة. هذا المزيج الخاص محمص بلون داكن للحصول على نكهة غنية وناعمة مع مظهر الشوكولاتة العميقة. تضمن محمصة التحميص الرئيسية لدينا تحقيق مستوى التحميص الدقيق لصنع هذه القهوة المعقدة اللذيذة التي تبقى المفضلة اليوم. يحتوي هذا المنتج على عبوة واحدة من 72 كبسولة قهوة واحدة (متوافقة مع كيوريج كيه-كوبز™). استمتع بـ 72 كوب من القهوة. نبذة عن كوميونيتي كوفي منذ كاب مزج المجموعة الأولى من قهوة كوميونيتي، رأينا الكثير من التغيير - داخل الشركة وخارجها. لقد تطورنا لخدمة عملائنا بشكل أفضل، ولكننا حاولنا أيضًا البقاء مخلصين لجذورنا والمجتمع الذي بدأنا. لهذا السبب حافظنا على مدى أكثر من 100 عام على تفاني لا يزعج لصنع أفضل أنواع القهوة وأكثرها جودة التي يمكن أن نستطيع أن نستطيع أن نستخدمها - كل ذلك مع تطوير طرق أفضل للحصول على تقنيات تحميص فائقة وأفكار مبتكرة للحفاظ على قهتنا في ذروة النكهة والنضارة. نحن ببساطة نحب صنع القهوة، ونجد الإلهام في كل جزء من العملية، من زراعة الحبوب إلى تقديم الكوب المثالي. فوق كل شيء، نحن مستلهمين من الأشخاص الذين نعمل معهم، والعملاء الذين نخدموا والوصلات التي قمنا ببناؤها معًا.

Há mais de quatro gerações, nosso fundador "Cap" Saurage criou nossa assinatura café torrado escuro. Esta mistura especial é torrada escura para desenvolver um sabor rico e suave com um perfil de chocolate profundo. Nossas torradeiras mestres garantem que o nível exato da torra seja alcançado para criar consistentemente este delicioso café complexo que permanece um favorito hoje. Este produto contém um único pacote de 72 cápsulas de café de porção única (compatível com Keurig K-Cups™). Desfrute de 72 xícaras de café. Sobre a Community Coffee Since Cap misturou o primeiro lote de café Community®, nós vimos muita mudança — tanto dentro como fora da empresa. Evoluímos para atender melhor aos nossos clientes, mas também tentamos manter-se fiéis às nossas raízes e à comunidade que nos ajudou a começar. É por isso que há mais de 100 anos temos mantido uma dedicação inabalável para fazer o café de melhor sabor e da mais alta qualidade que possamos — tudo enquanto desenvolvemos melhores métodos de fornecimento, técnicas de torragem superiores e ideias inovadoras para manter nosso café no auge de sabor e frescor. Simplesmente adoramos fazer café, e encontramos inspiração em todas as partes do processo, desde plantar os grãos até servir o copo perfeito. Acima de tudo, somos inspirados pelas pessoas com quem trabalhamos, pelos clientes que atendemos e pelas conexões que construímos juntos.

四代前,我們的創始人 "Cap" Saurage 創造了我們標誌性的深焙咖啡。 這種特殊的混合物經過深焙,可以形成豐富、光滑的風味和濃郁的巧克力輪廓。 我們的烘焙大師確保達到精確的烘焙水平,持續創造這款美味複合咖啡,至今仍然是最受歡迎的咖啡。 本產品包含一包 72 個單份咖啡膠囊(Keurig 相容的 K-Cups™)。 享受 72 杯咖啡。 關於 Community Coffee :Cap 混合了第一批 Community® 咖啡,我們看到了公司內外的巨大變化。 我們已進化為更好地服務客戶,但我們也努力忠實於我們的根本和社群,讓我們開始。 這就是為什麼 100 多年來,我們一直堅持不懈地致力於製作最美味、最高品質的咖啡 - 同時開發更好的採購方法、卓越的烘焙技巧和創新的想法,以保持我們的咖啡保持在最佳的風味和新鮮度。 我們只喜歡製作咖啡,從種植豆子到製作完美的杯子,我們在整個過程中都會找到靈感。 ​ 最重要的是,我們受到與我們合作的人員、我們為客戶以及我們一起建立的聯繫的啟發。

四代前,我们的创始人 "Cap" Saurage 创造了我们标志性的深色烘焙咖啡。 这种特殊的混合物是深烘焙的,形成丰富、光滑的口味,深巧克力轮廓。 我们的大师烘焙器确保精确的烘烤水平，始终如一地制作出这种美味复杂的咖啡，今天仍然是人们最爱的咖啡。 本产品包含一包 72 个咖啡胶囊(兼容 Keurig K-Cups™)。 享受72杯咖啡。 关于Community Coffee Since Cap 混合了第一批 Community® 咖啡,我们看到了大量的变化 — 公司内部和外部。 我们已经发展为更好地为我们的客户提供服务,但我们也试图忠于我们的根源和让我们开始的社区。 这就是为什么 100 多年来,我们一直坚定不懈地致力于制作我们能做到的优质咖啡 - 同时开发更好的采购方法、卓越的烘焙技术和创新想法,让我们的咖啡保持风味和新鲜度。 我们喜欢制作咖啡,我们在整个过程中的每个部分都找到灵感,从种植豆类到提供完美杯子。 最重要的是,我们受到我们与之合作的人、服务的客户以及我们建立在一起的关系的启发。

4세대에 걸쳐 설립자 "Cap" Saurage는 시그니처 다크 로스트 커피를 만들었습니다. 이 특별한 블렌드는 짙은 초콜릿 프로파일로 풍부하고 부드러운 맛을 개발하기 위해 어둡게 구워집니다. 당사의 마스터 로스터는 정확한 로스트 레벨을 달성하여 오늘날 가장 좋아하는 맛있고 복잡한 커피를 지속적으로 만들 수 있도록 보장합니다. 이 제품에는 72개의 싱글 서브 커피 포드 (Keurig 호환 K-Cups™)가 들어 있습니다. 72잔의 커피를 즐기세요. 커뮤니티 커피에 대해: Cap이 첫 번째 Community® 커피를 혼합하여 회사 내부와 외부 모두에서 많은 변화를 보았습니다. 당사는 고객에게 더 나은 서비스를 제공하기 위해 진화했지만 당사는 또한 뿌리와 커뮤니티에 충실하기 위해 노력했습니다. 그렇기 때문에 100년 이상 저희는 가능한 최고의 맛, 최고 품질의 커피를 만들기 위해 끊임없이 헌신을 해왔습니다. 더 나은 소싱 방법, 우수한 로스팅 기술 및 혁신적인 아이디어를 개발하면서 커피를 맛과 신선함을 최상으로 유지할 수 있습니다. 우리는 커피 만들기를 좋아하며, 콩을 심는 것부터 완벽한 컵을 제공하는 것까지 모든 과정에서 영감을 얻습니다. 무엇보다도, 저희는 함께 일하는 사람들, 봉사하는 고객, 그리고 저희가 함께 만든 연결성에서 영감을 얻었습니다.

description: There is an art that's worth perfecting when it comes to making iced coffee. There are two schools of thought when it comes to iced coffee, the hot-brewed and the cold-brewed. While they adhere to very different methods, there is one point both agree upon: pouring regular-brewed coffee over ice is nothing short of a travesty. Coffee is a fragile beverage, and it doesn't sustain extreme change in temperatures well. Often times, this will result in a coffee that is acrid, sour or weak. So, how do you make a good iced coffee? Well, it depends on your tastes and the way you perceive iced coffee. If you want an iced beverage that tastes like regular coffee, the hot-brewed method will give you that result. If you see iced and regular coffee as two separate entities, you may be a fan of the cold-brew variety. The hot-brewed method will result in a more robust flavor while the cold brew is mellow and naturally sweet. Ingredients 1 pound Ground Coffee (good, Rich Roast) 8 quarts Cold Water Half-and-half (healthy Splash Per Serving) Sweetened Condensed Milk (2-3 Tablespoons Per Serving) Note: Can Use Skim Milk, 2% Milk, Whole Milk, Sugar, Artificial Sweeteners, Syrups...adapt To Your Liking! Preparation: In a large container, mix ground coffee with water. Cover and allow to sit at room temperature eight hours or overnight. Line a fine mesh strainer with cheesecloth and set over a pitcher or other container. Pour coffee/water mixture through the strainer, allowing all liquid to run through. Discard grounds. Place coffee liquid in the fridge and allow to cool. Use as needed. To make iced coffee, pack a glass full of ice cubes. Fill glass 2/3 full with coffee liquid. Add healthy splash of half-and-half. Add 2-3 tablespoons sweetened condensed milk (can use plain sugar instead) and stir to combine. Taste and adjust half-and-half and/or sweetened condensed milk as needed.

description: Among the archipelago nation of Indonesia lies its hidden Jewel, the island of Bali. The eruption of the Gunung Agung Volcano in 1963 caused a delay in the progress of modern-day coffee cultivation on Bali. In response to this situation, the government enacted programs in the 1970’s and 1980’s to help rejuvenate coffee production. With the distribution of coffee seedlings to local farmers, an island wide coffee growing campaign began. Today, the coffee growing area in Bali is an estimated 7,500 hectares. The Kintamani highlands, where most coffee is grown, sits atop a large volcanic plateau between 1300-1700 meters altitude. Coffee tree varieties include a high percentage of Bourbon and Typica, along with shade trees such as Erythrina, Albizia, Tangerine and Orange. The use of pesticides is prohibited on Bali and all fertilizers are 100% organic. The Subak Abian is a traditional farming structure organization in Bali, similar to a farmer cooperative. There are 13 different Subak Abians that are currently growing and processing coffee. The “SA” oversee both agricultural technology and religious activities. The promotion of improved coffee growing practices is expected to enhance not only agricultural technology but social and economic standing in Bali as well. This Jewel among coffees stands out with smooth body and overwhelming chocolate flavors.

description:
Old faithful...but not at all boring!

*I am a happy mad scientist with coffee.* That’s how I’ve been described, anyway. I love playing “what if”- blending Fair Trade Organic beans, roast profiles, and natural funky flavors. When I discover a blend that is, as my Dad would say, "as close to perfect as damn is to swearing," I package it up and pass it on to all my Coffee Junkie friends. Once you taste truly fresh-roasted, naturally flavored coffees...you'll become a Coffee Junkie for life, and I'm OK with that!

Why it's important to grind just what you need just before you brew? Coffee stays fresh in the bean form for 3+ months. If you grind your coffee it is best brewed within 1 month. So, if you are a real coffee junkie and want the freshest coffee on the planet then you will want to grind and brew, grind and brew and so on and so on... Brew coffee like a real Coffee Junkie at home Invest in a coffee grinder. Grind your coffee according to your brewing method. Basic rule of thumb is if you use a filter the grind is not as crucial as if you brew without a filter.

Grind 3 tblsp of coffee beans for an 8oz cup of coffee. If you prefer a bolder cup add a bit more coffee. Prefer cold brew? It's a piece of cake to make! Course grind 8oz of Coffee Junkie coffee and place grounds in a coffee filter tied with a twist tie and in a pitcher. Pour 1 gallon of filtered water in the pitcher. Refrigerate over night or up to 24 hours. Remove the coffee ground pouch and voila... cold brew that is as close to perfect as damn is to swearing!

If you have any questions please feel free to ask, your coffee/tea must be "as close to perfect as damn is to swearing" or my work is not complete!

description: The washed coffees of Yirgacheffe have long been prized for their delicate, tea-like aromatics and clean citrus flavor. Recently, producers in the Gedio region have been reinventing the natural process originally developed in Ethiopia to offer a completely different profile from this well-known origin. The Misty Valley is a prime example of the fruitiness, complexity, and character of these Natural Yirgacheffe coffees. Developed by exporter and producer partner Abdullah Bagersh, the Natural Misty Valley is subject to an incredible amount of care from start to finish. When the ripe cherries are first brought to the mill to dry on raised African beds, they are constantly turned (day and night) for the first 48 hours of drying to ensure an even evaporation of the moisture from the cherry. This lends a consistency and cleanliness to the cup, which can prove difficult in a process prone to mold and uneven air circulation. After the coffee is fully dried and the skin, mucilage, and parchment removed, it is sorted and traded through the Ethiopian Coffee Exchange as a Grade 1 Yirgacheffe.

description: Arbuckles' Coffee began in the post Civil War Era of the 19th Century. Two brothers, John and Charles Arbuckle, initiated a new concept in the coffee industry; selling roasted coffee in one pound packages. Until that time, coffee was sold green and had to be roasted in a skillet over a fire or in a wood stove. The Arbuckle Brothers were able to roast a coffee that was of consistently exceptional quality and the first to be packaged in one pound bags. Arbuckles' Ariosa Blend became so popular in the Old West that most cowboys didn't even know that there was any other. Arbuckles' Coffee was prominent in such infamous cow towns as Dodge City and Tombstone. The Arbuckle Brothers enjoyed immense success into the 20th Century. However, the company was broken up by the family in the late 1930's. In 1974, Pat and Denney Willis were concerned with the inconsistent quality of coffee they were forced to serve in their restaurants. Pat and Denney knew that they could promise a consistently good cup of coffee, better than the competition; just what the Arbuckle Brothers had promised and fulfilled over 100 years earlier. Arbuckles' Coffee was reborn. Arbuckles' Coffee has garnered many acclaims throughout the coffee industry for their commitment to providing the consumer with freshly roasted coffee. Arbuckle operates their roasting facility deep in the heart of the Old West in historic Tucson, Arizona. Arbuckles' has resurrected the Original Arbuckles Ariosa Blend. It is packaged whole bean or ground in 1LB bags with a Peppermint stick, just as the Arbuckle Brothers had done over a century ago. John Arbuckle's hand written notes, before 1914, show he was trying to create a roasting process that suspended the coffee bean in air to avoid scorching from the hot metal roasting drum. It was not until the mid 1970's that Michael Sivetz patented a workable hot air roaster. Arbuckle now uses the hot air roasting process to bring you the coffee that won the west!

Fresh Roasted Coffee
The Fresh Roasted Coffee process begins at the source. Our coffees are chosen and established with great love and greater yet - consideration of origin, flavor profile and quality. All of these components help us to deliver consistent, exceptional coffee with true approachability.

Coffee Storage
Coffee has four age old enemies; heat, light, air and moisture. The way coffee is stored is essential to keeping it fresh and ready to enjoy. Storing coffee in conditions that expose it to these elements will allow for the coffee to lose its flavor rapidly. Fresh Roasted Coffee pods are nitrogen-sealed but should be stored out of direct sunlight and in an area not subject to great temperature changes. Coffee should not be stored in the freezer, contrary to popular belief, as it leads to moisture extracting the flavor of the coffee. Coffee is porous and will also absorb unwanted flavors from your freezer.

description: CINNAMON ROAST: A very lightly roasted coffee style that is dropped at beginning of first crack. Features a light aroma with a light body, the cup has an exceptionally light roast taste throughout. Bean surface is dry. – LIGHT ROAST: A more developed light roast style that is dropped towards the end of first crack. Its acidity is bright, the body is more developed, a fruity sweetness is beginning to present itself, and the cup resonates with an awesome light roast taste. Bean surface is dry. – BLONDE ROAST: A balanced light/medium roast style that features a bright, desirable fruit-like acidity, sweetness is more pronounced, body is good, with an overall bright, fruity, complex cup profile. Bean surface is dry. – MEDIUM ROAST: A dry coffee with no surface oils. At this roast level, the aromatics are nearing their peak, the cup is charged with complexity. Body is developing quite nicely, acidity is balanced easily making this our sweetest roast level for most beans. – FULL CITY ROAST: Cup remains balanced, complex, and is sweeter than can be found at the very lightest roast levels or at the very darkest roast levels. Aroma is at its peak levels, body and mouthfeel are round and full, providing an overall delicious cup with a nice pronounced finish. – ESPRESSO ROAST: Dark brown in color with an oily surface. The advantage is maximum body and texture, dark roast character yet with a pleasant sweetness creating a balanced cup. Many coffees roast well at this level and remain complex. – ITALIAN ROAST: Acidity is low, body is full, dark flavors are intense while there is still a sweetness present in the cup. Smoky undertones are beginning to appear in the cup. – HEAVY FRENCH: The cup quality has changed dramatically, with burnt undertones masking remaining cup attributes. Aroma, sweetness, and body fade as the pungent smokiness dominates the cupping notes. There is a definite following for this intensely strong style of very dark roasted coffee among U.S. coffee drinkers.
